selection: Minimum source-validation reconstruction loss, earliest epoch on ties; test outputs only after selected weights fixed.
target: Same v0.3 five-frame node/pair observations and masks in all six conditions; seven equally weighted loss groups; one joint player assignment across the window.
development_evidence: Recipe frozen after a source-only resource pilot. All nine series were already development data; this is not a final independent test.

architecture.mlp: Joint-permutation-average MLP: (5*(2*node_dim+1)+25*edge_dim)->128 GELU->64 LayerNorm; all 120 joint node/edge permutations.
architecture.graph: Node+validity+alive projection to 64; two 64-dimensional single-head distance-biased attention blocks with residual LayerNorm and 64->128 GELU->64 feedforward. Live-key masking, self attention allowed, sum pooling divided by five.
architecture.temporal: Graph: shared GRU(64,64) per consistent player track, then average five final states. MLP: shared GRU per consistent joint whole-window permutation view, then average 120 final states. Static conditions average encoded states over time/views without GRU.
architecture.decoder: 64->128 GELU->525 raw outputs: 5*5*15 node fields and 5*10*3 unordered pair fields; survival/region/ground logits, other fields unconstrained regression.

direct_controls.statistics_sequence: 24 scalars/frame: original 10 common-state/resource statistics; relative-height range and std; three ground-state fractions; two mean motion channels, mean absolute vertical motion and motion-known fraction; horizontal and absolute-height pair mean/max; pair-known indicator. Zero-fill undefined numeric summaries, retain indicators. Flatten five frames. Source-training-only coordinate standardization (std floored at 1e-6), mean squared vector distance.
direct_controls.full_input_matching: Min over 120 consistent five-frame player assignments of the equal mean of five squared-error blocks: 15 masked node fields; node feature-validity bits; three unordered-pair fields; unordered pair-validity bits; survival bits. Fixed v0.3 scales only; no fitted normalization. Invalid own-side observations are zero-filled with explicit mask blocks.
direct_controls.library: Same source-training windows for all methods; no query series; same-map cross-series and cross-map retrieval reported separately; stable candidate index breaks ties.
direct_controls.neural_distance: Mean squared distance between 64-dimensional embeddings; no test normalization or reranking.
direct_controls.status: Rules frozen here before matrix test outputs; direct-control ranking implementation belongs to E3-E4.

planned_contrasts: graph_gru vs mlp_gru at full input
interpretation_limits: Same input and decoder, but graph and MLP parameter counts are reported rather than exactly matched.
Temporal vs static contrasts include preservation of track correspondence and recurrent parameters, not a pure parameter-count intervention.
Input ablations are conditional on the specified graph-temporal architecture, not a full factorial design.
No model selected on test reconstruction, pattern or retrieval outcomes; all six conditions retained.
